sentences.text: Today, we will talk about Spain.
Spain is a sunny, colorful, and historic country in Europe.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is Spain?
Spain is in southern Europe.
It is on the Iberian Peninsula, next to Portugal and near France.
To the south, Spain is close to Africa.
It has coasts on the Atlantic Ocean and the Mediterranean Sea.
Spain also has islands like the Balearic Islands and the Canary Islands.
What is the capital city of Spain?
The capital city is Madrid.
Madrid is a big city with parks, museums, palaces and shops.
It is in the center of the country.
Other famous cities include Barcelona by the sea with art and beaches.
Seville with flamenco music and dancing.
Valencia, Granada and Bilbao.
How many people live in Spain?
About 48 million people live in Spain.
Many people live in cities, but there are also villages and countryside.
Spain has many cultures and languages.
What language do people speak in Spain?
The official language is Spanish, also called Castilian.
But there are also regional languages such as Catalan in Barcelona and Catalonia, Galician in Galicia, Basque in the Basque Country.
Many people also speak English, especially in tourist areas.
What is the weather like in Spain?
Spain has different climates.
In the south it is hot and dry.
In the north it is cooler and sometimes rainy.
The islands have warm weather all year.
In summer some places are very hot over 35 degrees.
In winter it can snow in the mountains.
What does Spain look like?
Spain has many landscapes, beaches and coastlines, mountains like the Pyrenees and Sierra Nevada, green hills in the north, olive farms and vineyards, historic towns and colorful cities.
Spain is a country with nature, culture and sunshine.
What animals live in Spain?
In the wild you can find deer, wolves, foxes, eagles and owls.
Spain also has sheep, goats, horses and cows.
In the south you may see flamingos and lizards.
What do people eat in Spain?
Spanish food is tasty, fresh and shared.
People eat bread, olive oil and cheese, fish, seafood chicken and ham, vegetables, rice and beans.
Popular dishes include paila, rice with seafood or meat, tortilla espagnola, a potato omelet, gaspacho, cold tomato soup, tapas, small plates to share, churros, fried dough with chocolate.
Meals are often long and social.
What do people drink in Spain?
People drink water, coffee and tea, juice and milk.
Adults may drink wine, sangria or beer.
In the summer, people enjoy cold drinks like horchata or lemon soda.
What is life like in Spain?
Life in Spain is relaxed, friendly and family centered.
People enjoy eating together, talking and laughing, spending time outside.
There is a break in the afternoon called the siesta in some places.
People often go out at night for dinner, music or a walk.
What are some holidays and traditions in Spain?
Samanasanta, holy week before Easter with big processions.
La Tomatina, a tomato throwing festival, San Fermín, running of the bulls in Pamplona.
Christmas with gifts and family meals.
Three Kings Day, January 6th with parades and sweet bread.
National Day, October 12th.
There are also many local festivals with dancing, music and fireworks.
Some fun facts about Spain.
Spain has 47 UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
The Spanish flag is red and yellow.
Spain is famous for flamenco, soccer and art.
The painter Pablo Picasso was from Spain.
Spain is one of the most visited countries in the world.
Now you know many things about Spain.
You know where it is, what people speak and what they eat.
You learned about the cities, culture and daily life.
Well done.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emily.
